q: The λ-lemma (inclination lemma) for a hyperbolic fixed point states that any disk transverse to W^s eventually:
opts: Has iterates that are C¹-close to the unstable manifold W^u on compact subsets
Is mapped to a fixed disk
exp: λ-lemma (Palis): if a disk D is transverse to W^s at a point p ∈ W^u, then the images T^n(D) approach (in C¹) a disk in W^u as n → ∞. This is used to prove the stable manifold theorem and analyse homoclinic tangencies.
